title: physaria kingii subsp. diversifolia
intro: Physaria kingii subsp. diversifolia, commonly known as Purple Phacelia or Purple Bladderpod, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in protecting against cell damage and reducing inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Purple Phacelia include its potential to inhibit tumor growth and exhibit antimicrobial activity, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and other glucosinolates, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
